name: switchyard-change-fabric-service-api
description: A multi-resource JSON API Worker with a planted cross-resource gap: every resource skips input validation and auth. Each resource owns its own fix over two frozen shared contracts (requireAuth, json/problem).

scripts.typecheck: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/contracts/auth.js && node --check src/contracts/response.js && node --check src/resources/users.js && node --check src/resources/orders.js && node --check src/resources/products.js && node --check src/resources/auth.js && node --check src/resources/search.js && node --check src/resources/notifications.js && node --check src/ui.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && node --test gate/gate.test.mjs gate/bugfix.test.mjs
